basis: 23 equally weighted official Success Criteria checkboxes; no partial credit

criteria.criterion: The agent module loads and runs inside Logos Core alongside the wallet, storage, and messaging modules without requiring modifications to those modules.
criteria.note: Native module in Basecamp and fresh headless Linux deployment. Final source/assets must match.

criteria.criterion: The agent has its own shielded LEZ account and can send and receive tokens independently of the owner's wallet.
criteria.note: The agent wallets are separate; private wallet.send confirmed at block 3703.

criteria.criterion: The owner can deploy the agent and configure it with a single CLI command on any machine using Logos Core headless.
criteria.note: Fresh one-command Linux deployment and in-app local setup observed; dependencies must first be installed.

criteria.criterion: The owner can interact with the agent in real time from a separate Logos app instance using Logos Messaging, with no intermediary server.
criteria.note: Separate owner app communicates over authenticated encrypted Logos Messaging; cross-machine Exa flow is also recorded.

criteria.criterion: The spending threshold mechanism correctly holds above-threshold transactions for owner approval and executes below-threshold transactions autonomously.
criteria.note: Recorded above-threshold hold and no-owner-click private paid task. Public payments intentionally require a fresh explicit review.

criteria.criterion: All default skills listed above are implemented and documented.
criteria.note: All 21 required default skills are registered and documented, with completed receipts in the current role journals. Current A2A cancellation, paid failure/refund and restart recovery are separately observed.

criteria.criterion: Agent-to-agent coordination is A2A-compatible: Agent Cards follow the A2A schema, task interactions follow the A2A task lifecycle, and the implementation is documented as an A2A transport binding over Logos Messaging.
criteria.note: Cards and lifecycle use the documented Logos Messaging transport binding. Unmodified HTTP-only A2A clients still need that binding.

criteria.criterion: Two or more agents can discover each other via Agent Cards, execute a task following the A2A lifecycle, and transfer LEZ payment autonomously, without owner intervention.
criteria.note: Publicly discovered, non-owner-contact text-statistics provider was paid without an owner payment click.

criteria.criterion: At least 3 of the illustrative use cases above are demonstrated end-to-end on LEZ testnet.
criteria.note: File-vault round trip, paid marketplace and two-provider aggregation have end-to-end receipts.

criteria.criterion: Three separate agents are deployed on LEZ testnet — one per default skill category (Storage, Messaging, and Blockchain) — each with a demonstrated, reproducible deployment and evidence provided.
criteria.note: Separate Storage, Messaging and Blockchain role identities and deployments are recorded.

criteria.criterion: Full documentation — including the skill interface spec, deployment guide, and owner interaction guide — and a clean public repository are delivered.
criteria.note: Current source is not yet a clean matching public release.

criteria.criterion: Provide a documented skill interface (module/SDK) that can be used to add new skills without modifying the core agent module.
criteria.note: Hash-pinned subprocess skill interface and installation documentation; actual third-party text-statistics service was called and paid.

criteria.criterion: The owner-facing interface is accessible from the Logos app (Basecamp) via the owner channel — local build instructions and loadable assets are provided.
criteria.note: Live Basecamp owner channel, local setup, public service review and clickable tool summaries observed. Final stable-row/scrolling patch and matching assets still need verification.

criteria.criterion: The agent module recovers from transient failures (network interruptions, node restarts) without losing pending task state.
criteria.note: The provider retained the exact pending unpaid task and quote across restart, reconnected, and accepted cancellation. Previous mailbox/identity recovery evidence also remains. This is not a claim of a mid-payment crash replay.

criteria.criterion: Above-threshold transactions that fail to reach the owner for approval are not executed — the agent retries notification before timing out and reports the failure.
criteria.note: Verified in recorded UI/runtime observations; final release must retain it.

criteria.criterion: Skill failures are isolated: a failing skill does not crash the module or affect other concurrently running skills.
criteria.note: Actual independent discovery remained running while an installed JSON-formatting skill failed; event sequence and strictly contained timestamps prove overlap. Discovery completed and the controller remained live.

criteria.criterion: Document the compute unit (CU) cost of each on-chain operation the agent performs (token transfers, program calls, deployments) on LEZ devnet/testnet. Note: LEZ's per-transaction compute budget may change during testnet.
criteria.note: Operation-specific resource costs are documented with verified upstream source. This pinned LEZ API has no metered CU-used receipt; unavailable CU is explicitly distinguished from guest cycles, byte length and proof wall time.

criteria.criterion: The agent module is deployed and tested on LEZ devnet/testnet.
criteria.note: Current-testnet default wallet/program and paid-service receipts exist.

criteria.criterion: End-to-end integration tests run against a LEZ sequencer (standalone mode) and are included in CI.
criteria.note: Real local proof passed; final-version CI integration still pending.

criteria.criterion: CI must be green on the default branch.
criteria.note: No green default-branch run for the unfinished current tree.

criteria.criterion: A README documents end-to-end usage: deployment steps, agent configuration, and step-by-step instructions for deploying and interacting with the agent via CLI and the Logos app owner channel.
criteria.note: README contains headless deployment, role selection, owner CLI/Basecamp interaction, provider discovery, explicit public/private choice, and linked setup guides. Final source/assets publication is tracked separately in #11.

criteria.criterion: A reproducible end-to-end demo script is provided and works against a real local sequencer with `RISC0_DEV_MODE=0`.
criteria.note: Real standalone private proof completed using prerequisites already installed. This does not verify clean dependency installation or the later public-payment changes.

criteria.criterion: A recorded video demo of the end-to-end flow is included in the submission; the recording must show terminal output (including proof generation) to confirm `RISC0_DEV_MODE=0` was active.
criteria.note: Builder-narrated video is intentionally last.
